context:
Goal: after a sync merges changes, the phone tells you what changed, in the same words as the web.
Problem (rule): the web words the notice with mergeSummary in src/merge-rules.mjs. The native build keeps the merge rules out of its bundle, so the phone can't call it. Which module holds the phone's wording waits on your ruling.
Based on (read): SyncClient keeps the stats of the last reply, and no screen shows them.
Based on (read): git grep finds no mergeSummary in native.
Departs from: build.mjs:RULES_OUT — the merge rules stay out of native rules.js; option a bundles mergeSummary into it.
Meanwhile: the phone shows no merge notice.
home: pins lane: bundle mergeSummary into native rules.js; restyle after step 10: the notice screen

options.gain: One home for the wording; the phone always says what the web says.
options.how: The native rules.js gains mergeSummary, and a phone screen shows its text after a merge.
options.label: Bundle mergeSummary into the phone's rules

options.gain: The bundle stays as it is.
options.how: A Swift copy of the wording builds the notice.
options.label: Write the wording in Swift
options.lose: Two copies of one wording, which can drift apart.

ref: debt native-merge-notice-unbuilt (no native screen shows the merge notice); src/merge-rules.mjs mergeSummary
title: Where should the phone's merge notice wording come from: the web's rule, or a Swift copy?
why: It keeps one home for the wording, the same way item 43 option a keeps one home for the restore rule.
